hero.title: What do missed calls really cost you?
hero.description: In a few seconds, work out how much time and revenue NEXAI brings back, with your own numbers.

Roi.modeLabel: What would you like to calculate?

modeHint.money: Revenue recovered from calls that would otherwise be lost.
modeHint.time: Time your team no longer spends on the phone.

Roi.note: Non-binding example calculation. The share of calls captured by the voice agent is typically around 70 to 80 % depending on setup (default 75 %). Annual projection based on 5 working days per week (260 days).
Roi.ctaHint: We'll show you how realistic this number is for your business.
